verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own observability docs describe real-time browser screen recording and replay in the Browserbase session dashboard. That covers the video/replay part of the story, but only when runs use the Browserbase backend, not local or CDP-attached browsers. The `screenshot` tool is an agent-facing action rather than a debugging artifact, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: replay or recording for local and CDP runs, a documented step-by-step action timeline for agent runs, a screenshot history tied to failed steps, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of debugging failed runs from replays.
